# Ostia Antica - Harbour City of Ancient Rome

> > A comprehensive digital resource exploring Ostia Antica and Portus, the ancient harbour cities that served as Rome's vital maritime gateway.

This educational virtual museum documents the archaeological sites of Ostia and Portus, examining their role in Roman logistics, commerce, and urban development. The site features scholarly research on ancient port infrastructure, the Tiber River transport system, and the archaeological heritage of the Parco Archeologico di Ostia Antica.

## Key Topics

- Ostia Antica
- Portus
- Ancient Rome harbour system
- Roman archaeology
- Isola Sacra necropolis
- Tiber River shipping
- Ancient Roman logistics
- Via Ostiensis
- Via Campana
- Monte Testaccio
- Parco Archeologico di Ostia Antica
- Roman port infrastructure
- Ancient maritime commerce
- Harbour city urban planning

## Introduction & Overview

- [Ostia - Harbour City of Ancient Rome](https://www.ostia-antica.org/index.html): Homepage for Ostia, Ancient Rome's harbour city archaeological resource
- [Ostia - Harbour City of Ancient Rome](http://www.ostia-antica.org/): Main site entry for Ostia Antica virtual museum and educational resource

## Ancient Roman Logistics & Transportation

- [Transport from Ostia and Portus to Rome](https://www.ostia-antica.org/introduction/rome.htm): Guide to ancient logistics via Tiber River and Monte Testaccio warehousing
- [Leaving Rome](https://www.ostia-antica.org/vie/vie.htm): Roman roads including Via Ostiensis and Via Campana from Rome to ports
